name: Prestige Mode: Chromie winds a level-60 character back to level 1 and locks its specialization until 60
contract: The client's Prestige window (AscensionUI/Gossips/PrestigeMode.lua) takes over the gossip of creature 178081 and finds its buttons by exact option text, so Chromie offers 'I would like to prestige!', 'I would like to purchase Prestige items!' and 'GOSSIP_ACTION_EXPERIENCE_ITEMS' in that order. Choosing the first at level 60 returns the character to level 1 with no experience, and it earns 'Prestige 1': the Prestige Challenge aura 9930831 (the aura C_Player:IsPrestiged() reads), one Prestigious Cache 1287330, 100000 Runes of Ascension 375250 and 100 Tokens of Prestige 90004, on top of whatever the character already carried. The active specialization loses what level 1 does not allow: Fleshweaver's level-10 identity passive 681078, the level-20 class spell 504897 and Sanguine Mend's level-56 rank (504085). Sanguine Mend costs rage, so its ranks supersede one another; its rank 1, 802310, is the usable rank again rather than a superseded one, and it takes back the button the removed rank held. The level-20 spell's button is cleared and returns when the spell is learned again. The ordinary zone quest Raven Hill (163) can be done again, while the Stockade dungeon quest What Comes Around... (386) stays done. The hearthstone, bound in Stormwind before, is bound to the racial starting location and the character is sent there. Until level 60 the specialization is locked: .localspec to Sanguine (26) is refused and grants no Sanguine Thirst 92112. Reaching level 60 completes the cycle: the aura is removed and the switch works. A second activation pays the same rewards again.
